$comment: This file IS the provider toggle: switching models requires no application
code change and no restart. The active provider is surfaced in the UI.
Ollama is declared natively as an OpenAI-compatible provider, so no
Anthropic-compatibility shim sits on the demo-critical path.
NOTE: baseUrl here is a template. Pi interpolates credentials ($VAR in
'key'/'apiKey') but NOT baseUrl, so the app rewrites this value from
OLLAMA_BASE_URL when it materializes a writable Pi config home. Editing this
line alone will not change the URL the agent uses -- set OLLAMA_BASE_URL.
The 'anthropic' entry only OVERRIDES the base URL of Pi's built-in
Anthropic provider -- its model list and OAuth/API-key auth still apply.
When ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset the value is unresolved, so Claude models
report as unavailable WITH A REASON rather than silently disappearing.
